name: unicaronas
description: **Conectando estudantes para trajetos seguros, econômicos e sustentáveis.**

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names BACKEND,FRONTEND,BROWSER --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:open"
scripts.dev:open: node -e "setTimeout(() => { const exec = require('child_process').exec; const url = 'http://localhost:5500/pages/login.html'; if (process.platform === 'win32') exec(`start ${url}`); else exec(`npx open-cli ${url}`); }, 2000)"
